items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got the first opportunity to travel with Eddie Harris. He had Harold Jones was his drummer and Harold was going to music school. He had some finals that he had to be around for so I subbed for Harold.

ctx.x: And about how long were you working with him at this point?
It varies. It was on and off for a few years I think. But in between that I was working with people like Eddie Harris and Pat.
Was Pat Patrick already in Sun Ra's band at this point too?
